facebook.caption:
POV: you're staying at Sonasea and somehow walk past the best café on Bãi Trường every single morning.

LOLO BAKERY & CAFE sits right inside the resort complex on Đường Bào. Korean-run, 4.4 stars, 464 reviews deep. The pastry case alone is worth the detour.

Mid-range pricing ($15-30/person) for a sit-down café spread that actually delivers. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
